name: Countering Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can prepare a spell in such a way that it is much more useful for counterspelling.

Prerequisites: Improved Counterspell.

Benefit: A countering spell can be used to counterspell any spell of the same level or lower. A countering spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell’s actual level.
